feature: CRM-native leads and shared follow-up tasks

flows.name: Prospect to account workflow
steps: Create a CRM-native lead with an organization and optional contact details
Create lead-targeted deals, activities, and shared follow-up tasks
Progress the lead and its deal without creating an Acumatica company
Explicitly link the lead to an approved CRM account when conversion is appropriate
Atomically reparent deals, activities, and tasks to the linked account
flows.expectedOutcome: A prospect can move through real deal flow without appearing in Acumatica until an explicit, authorized conversion

checks: Add Lead asks for an organization rather than an Acumatica company
The dialog and CRM relationship workspace are not stacked or clipped
Table and card views remain usable at their intended viewports

claims.description: Production supports CRM-native leads without inserting or updating companies
Lead deals, activities, and follow-up tasks use the governed CRM and Tasks boundaries
The authenticated Add Lead workflow renders correctly on desktop and mobile
Invalid lead, relationship, owner, and conversion states fail closed
Focused UI, API, SQL, lint, type, and review checks pass
